assessment.price_case: Main line 21.5 at -110 needs roughly a 52-in-100 hit rate to break even. The line matches the four-book median, and no qualified probability can be compared with it.
assessment.context_case: The Payton play-calling and Seattle pass-defense claims come from an unverified lead and are not sourced here. No supplied report addresses Nix's status or role.

qualitative_review.countercase: A quick, short-read passing game can keep completions steady even if yardage falls. Two of his last four games went over this line, and a trailing script against a strong Seattle team could add volume. This prop is also correlated with the attempts under, so the two do not confirm each other.

findings.note: Denver's final report rules out All-Pro CB Pat Surtain II and starting S Talanoa Hufanga with ankle injuries, and lists CB Riley Moss (ribs) as questionable after he was limited all week and missed Week 5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who leads the NFL in receiving yards and TDs, practiced fully Wednesday and has no game status, so he is set to face Denver's weakened secondary; WR Irv Charles is on track to debut.

Seattle has ruled out starting LB Drake Thomas, with Tyrice Knight starting in his place, and RB Zach Charbonnet, while rookie RB Jadarian Price is on IR, leaving Emanuel Wilson and George Holani to lead an inconsistent run game.

Denver is without All-Pro CB Patrick Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga, and CB Riley Moss is questionable. Seattle WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba and DT Leonard Williams have no game status, so both are cleared to play.

Seattle's team site says Denver's injured secondary could push Seattle to lean on its passing game. That offense is led by Smith-Njigba, who leads the NFL in receiving yards and TDs, though Denver's defense is still described as one of the league's best.

Both teams are 3-2 and Denver is 2-0 at home this season. Separately, ESPN reports Seattle will be without starting LB Drake Thomas (Tyrice Knight starts) and RB Zach Charbonnet. No analyst picks on the spread showed up in the search.
